# Building AI Agents for Credit Risk Analysis

## Overview of Today's Practical Session

- Generate synthetic credit application data
- Train LLM-based credit risk models
- Build multi-agent systems with CrewAI
- Create automated credit risk reports
- Evaluate model performance and agent effectiveness

## Session Structure

### Part 1: Data Generation (30 minutes)
- Create synthetic credit application dataset
- Include structured and unstructured data
- Generate realistic default probabilities

### Part 2: Model Training (30 minutes)
- Process text data with embeddings
- Train classification models
- Evaluate performance metrics

### Part 3: AI Agent Development (30 minutes)
- Design multi-agent credit analysis system
- Implement agent collaboration workflows
- Generate automated risk reports

## Key Technologies

- **CrewAI**: Multi-agent orchestration
- **OpenAI API**: Language model integration
- **Transformers**: Text processing and embeddings
- **Scikit-learn**: Machine learning models
- **Pandas**: Data manipulation and analysis

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, you will be able to:
- Generate realistic synthetic credit data
- Implement LLM-based credit risk models
- Design and deploy AI agent systems
- Create automated credit analysis workflows
- Evaluate the effectiveness of agent-based solutions

## Prerequisites

- OpenAI API key configured
- Required Python packages installed
- Basic understanding of credit risk concepts
- Familiarity with machine learning workflows
